description: Analyze policy documents (and optional behavioral decision logs) to detect contradictions, hidden rules, and gaps between declared policy and observed behavior. Stateless — no artifact is created and nothing is persisted. Returns contradiction types: threshold_conflicts (numeric rule overlaps), ghost_terms (undefined terms used in rules), role_conflicts (same action allowed by one role, denied by another), rule_collisions (direct logical conflicts), and layer_divergences (policy says X but behavioral data shows Y).

behavioral_logs.description: Optional historical decision records. Enables layer_divergence detection — surfaces behavioral patterns that deviate from written policy.

items.description: One row of historical decision data.

documents.description: Policy documents to analyze for contradictions.

content.description: Plain text content of the document.

name: detect_contradictions

hidden_rules.description: Rules inferred from behavior not in written policy
